title: MP govt lawyers use AI to draft defence in cop's dismissal case, cite non-existent Supreme Court judgment, high court raps them for blindly relying on AI
description: In a striking session, the Madhya Pradesh High Court scolded the state government's lawyer for citing a non-existent Supreme Court ruling during a case about a former sub-inspector's dismissal due to inappropriate conduct. The judge pointed out the critical need for accurate legal references and warned against the potential dangers of depending on artificial intelligence for drafting legal documents. Future cases must have all legal claims thoroughly verified.
